findings.note: Late Blocks from steps 10-13 deliberately omit context_binding and resolver even though those values are already computable. The design requires a full Resolver Evidence record for these paths; only early pre-discovery cases receive reduced records. Schema permissiveness does not satisfy this semantic requirement.

The snapshot-mismatch stub emits 64 bare hex characters, while the step-6 dependency contract requires a sha256:<64-hex> value and mandates dependency-output-malformed otherwise. Because the fixture passes as snapshot-generation-mismatch, the implementation or test harness accepts a dependency output shape forbidden by the specification, so this test does not validly verify the intended TOCTOU branch.
